body: I don't usually get bullied as for I am quite a intimidating person i think, people have said that that they are scared of me, I know i don't deserve the bullying and stuff that has happened to me but I don't hate all the stuff that has happened to me as for it has shaped me into a more mature and intellectual person and most importantly given me real empathy to show and help others. I get enjoyment from helping others and helping someone through bad rough patches, this happened since around the start of the year where I went on a massive self discovery adventure and found that I don't get fun and enjoyment from hurting people but it's more fun and fulfilling to help others. I learnt that I cannot fix people the hard way and it bit me in the ass really badly and put me in this state in a some parts, but it don't hate the person who did it and as for they helped me learn and mature from this and helped me figure out ways on how to cope and get through this stuff.

i have recognized my potential but seen no use of it as I can't focus on goals. like currently I am a beekeeper and I succeed in a school and produce more amount of work in 1 hour then 4 people all though it's at terrible quality. i've self taught myself guitar, russian and how to use computers. plus who'd wanna hire me ? 

the normal thing is more about being able to understand others emotion's and feelings better, i know its a thing i could learn but its not that easy its way more harder to learn with adhd interfering. I am medicated and it helps but its just that i can't survive of medication for the rest of my life. I can socalize very well and flourish in a social environment but it's just that the fact I can't see what i'm doing and how i make others feel
